<subject>Key Achievements for the First Half of 2021</subject>
<body>
My key achievements for the first half of 2021 are as follows:

1. Developed New Trading Documentation – provided essential legal expertise and intellectual input to redesign trading forms to align more closely with standard industry templates.

2. Created Setoff and Netting Strategy during the Albion Power Group Insolvency – led the legal and credit teams across all Kestrel Aerospace divisions to minimise credit and legal exposure. This involved rapid assessment of the company’s positions and coordination across all units to determine the best approach to terminate and value Albion Power contracts.

3. Implemented New Document Retention Policy for Email Systems – spearheaded resolution of critical document retention challenges and introduced a new policy across all departments at Kestrel Aerospace.

4. Legal Risk Management Leadership – continued to advance legal frameworks for improved management and reporting of legal risks across Kestrel Aerospace. Examples include Legal Risk Briefings and risk rating methodologies. These policies have recently been applied in our South America and Energy divisions to enhance legal risk evaluation and control.

5. Business Development Support – played a key role in supporting new business ventures in aerospace logistics, materials, and engineering services by preparing trading forms and devising innovative legal risk management strategies.

6. Complex Project Oversight – involved in multiple high-profile projects with complex legal issues including Falcon II, Meridian Energy, Voyager Systems, ElectraTech, and Hawk Industries.

7. Team Leadership – continued to build a commercially savvy legal team with strong understanding of underlying business operations.

8. Next-Generation Master Agreements – leading collaboration with the International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA) to develop a unified master agreement for all commodities, physical and financial, aimed at halving legal workload.
</body>
